subject: leanrea
title: Pipes break when copied
fix: Router is data and the skill is generated with lists and fenced blocks, no tables (§4); CI runs each generated command on Linux, macOS and Windows.

subject: leanrea
title: Broad benchmark Bash permission, no sandbox
fix: Every benchmark arm runs in the same sandbox with a filtered environment (§10), built in the Phase 0c harness (§9).

subject: leanrea
title: Unquoted rm -rf $X, TMPDIR
fix: Scratch is created and swept by the daemon under REAX_HOME/tmp/<job> (§3.3), so the skill has no rm -rf. Not in the plan: shellcheck the generated fallback commands.

subject: leanrea
title: Ghidra DecompileAll.java missing; libraries over-imported; .unpacked must be copied
evidence: PR #5, 2026-10-18; confirmed: Text confirmed (:42); Ghidra not testable here
fix: Ghidra runs through a pyghidra worker, not a missing script (§3.6); app.asar.unpacked is read in place by @electron/asar (§3.8).

subject: leanrea
title: macOS-only; TMPDIR; mawk; cp -c; Go symbols after -s -w
evidence: PR #8, 2026-10-24; confirmed: Yes for TMPDIR, mawk, cp -c (my test; GNU cp rejects -c, so the PR's stated reason differs). Go: consistent with known behaviour, not tested
fix: Skill fallbacks tested on Linux, macOS and Windows (§4); trap T10 for Go -s -w (§4); built-in readers remove the need for cp -c, mawk and TMPDIR.

subject: leanrea
title: Tasks are "checklist-style"; no Ghidra/Hopper/IDA
evidence: YouTube 0Otn8QGGtRw comment, per one search summary, ~2026-10; confirmed: Consistent with README.md:45 and tasks.json; the comment itself was not seen
fix: At least 30 oracle tasks on generated fixtures including resume and adversarial tasks, with real engines in the arms (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Numbers are self-reported; narrow task set
evidence: developersdigest.tech, discuss.pytorch.kr (dates not visible); confirmed: Consistent with BENCHMARK.md:76
fix: PREREG.md committed before runs, raw transcripts committed, results never hand-edited, misses published (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Compared with Anthropic skill best practices: "Provide utility scripts", which are "more reliable than generated code"; "Prefer scripts for deterministic operations"; feedback loops "Run validator → fix errors → repeat"; "Avoid assuming tools are installed"; "At least three evaluations"; "Tested ...
evidence: No scripts (PR #5 would add the first); no validation loop; assumes tools; 4 evals, one model (Sonnet); single file (fine at 66 lines)
fix: Generated skill calls deterministic reax operations, falls back to plain commands that work on each platform, and is tested on three OSes and two model tiers (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Compared with GhidraMCP: Decompile, list methods/classes/imports/exports, rename methods and data; headless mode with --project DIR keeps the project and saves changes between runs
evidence: Ghidra used only as a one-shot headless dump, with a missing script; no persistent project or annotations
fix: Persistent Ghidra projects and annotate with read-back (§3.5).

subject: leanrea
title: Compared with ida-pro-mcp: Decompile, xrefs, call graphs, rename, set types, comments, patch; per-database sessions; debugger tools off by default; --max-workers
evidence: No xrefs or call graph except the otool literal-pool trick; no write-back; no session concept
fix: Xrefs and call graphs (§8 C09), annotate (§3.5) and sessions (§3.4 session tool); patching is out of scope (§13).

subject: leanrea
title: Compared with radare2-mcp: Read-only mode -R; sandbox lock; restricted tool sets; supervisor approvals (r2mcp approve); "yolo" mode needed for run tools
evidence: No read-only or approval mode; running targets is just a row of commands (:55)
fix: Read tools split from mutating ones (§3.4), approval queue (§0), sandbox (§3.6); runtime off by default (§13).

subject: leanrea
title: Compared with REA: MCP server + CLI; evidence with stated limitations; integrity checks and digests (fails closed on asar integrity mismatch, rea:src/cli/artifactCommands.ts:199-201 per anatomy); providers Hopper/Ghidra/IDA/objdump/Rizin/JEB/JADX/Apktool/Binwalk/TShark; setup shows changes for ap...
evidence: No integrity check, no evidence store, no provider abstraction, no approval step, no legal or authorised-use note
fix: reax supplies digests and integrity checks, an evidence store (§3.2), an adapter contract (§3.6), an approval gate (§0) and a fail-closed scope.md (§13).

subject: leanrea
title: A file read two ways. One file has to work as Markdown that people read on GitHub and as raw text that models copy from. The table format cannot do both. Lists or fenced blocks can.
fix: Generated skill uses lists and fenced blocks, never tables (§4); a test renders it and executes its commands raw.

subject: leanrea
title: Platform scope. The README claims coverage of PE, ELF, firmware and websites (SKILL.md:3), but the benchmark covers only macOS.
fix: Fixture corpus spans PE, ELF and Mach-O built with zig cc (§9 0c), and the skill is tested on Linux, macOS and Windows (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Escaped pipes in the Router: 15 | occurrences in 6 rows (:38, :41, :42, :44, :45, :52). Copied raw, they become literal arguments: shell pipes break and rg alternations match nothing. :38's long rg regex uses unescaped |, so on GitHub the cell splits. Correction to anatomy L5: :38 is mostly unesc...
evidence: my test: printf 'bl x\ncall y\n' | rg -c 'bl|call' → exit 1 (0 matches), unescaped → 2. strings -a /usr/bin/ls | rg -m1 x → "strings: invalid option -- 'm'". jq HAR filter → "syntax error, unexpected INVALID_CHARACTER". Count: grep -o '\|' SKILL.md | wc -l → 15 (PR #6 says 13)
fix: No Markdown tables in the generated skill (§4); each command is executed in CI as copied from the raw file.

subject: leanrea
title: Router coverage per platform: Linux, this container: 2/18 rows run as written, 9 partly, 7 not (§5.3). No Linux or Windows first move. cp -c rejected by GNU cp 9.4. TMPDIR unset. Default awk is mawk. GNU nm cannot read Mach-O
evidence: my test: which sweep (32 of 60 tools missing, incl. lipo, otool, xcrun, codesign, ilspycmd, jadx, apktool, WABT, sqlite3, plutil, tshark, binwalk, unblob, frida, adb, brew); cp -c … → "invalid option -- 'c'"; echo $TMPDIR → unset; nm -gU macho/Updater → "file format not recognized"
fix: Built-in readers replace otool, lipo and nm on every host (§8 C07, C12); fallbacks are correct per platform and tested on Linux, macOS and Windows (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Enforcement: Prose only: work on a copy; per-target dir; slice not cat; cap outputs; batch; label claims; budget 2–4 calls; stop rule; do not re-verify; consent before install. Nothing blocks breaking any of them
evidence: code shows: no hook, script or tool in the repo (README.md:9 "one SKILL.md"). Assay pe-facts rep 3: "I read the file in place … without copying it" (assay:bench/results/live.json, tier0 pe-facts 3)
fix: Prose rules become enforcement: caps and handles in tools, labels as fields, untrusted envelope, approval gate (§4); targets are read in place read-only by digest (§3.5).

subject: leanrea
title: Budgets: Turn budget stated (:18), not enforced. Measured only in the benchmark: leanrea runs 1–6 tool calls, >4 in 5/12 (native-11: 6; deep-11, deep-12, deep-13, electron-13: 5). Output caps stated, not measured. Cost/time limits exist only in run.py
evidence: my test: recount of final.jsonl tools lists
fix: Per-call deadlines and budgets (§3.4); turns and tool calls measured for every arm (§4, §10); investigate takes a budget (§5).
note: A client's turn count cannot be enforced by tools; only measured and reduced.

subject: leanrea
title: Labels: Guarantee nothing: no field, no check that a "seen" citation exists or supports the claim, not graded (tasks.json has no label key). Assay Haiku runs: 6/24 answers contain none of the words seen/inferred/unknown (js-app 1, 2, 3; npm-postinstall 2; elf-facts 3; version-pair 3)
evidence: my test: word counts over assay live.json tier0 answers
fix: Labels are fields on every claim (§4) and the grader grades labels (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Benchmark: tasks, grading, oracle, contamination: 4 tasks on 3 targets from 2 products; 25 regex keys; no negative keys; 3 keys match any mention (hash, \.sock, JSON, tasks.json:43,45,48); one false negative fixed by hand (BENCHMARK.md:41). Oracle reproducible only with macOS + Notion 7.35.1 + gh...
evidence: code shows tasks.json:1-50, run.py:43-44; my recomputation of final.jsonl
fix: Oracle predicates, penalties for refuted claims, vocabulary normalisation, grader self-test, generated uncontaminated fixtures, at least 30 tasks (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Install and update: npx skills add from repo head; npx skills update pulls latest; no version field, tag or changelog; pinning only by manual clone. Snippets run npx -y unpinned (:29, :38, :39); install line unpinned (:66)
evidence: code shows README.md:50-68, SKILL.md:1-4; ls-remote shows no tags
fix: Skill published pinned by tag to the skills directory and MCP Registry (§4), with CHANGELOG and semver (§13). Not in the plan: fallback snippets pin package versions instead of npx -y.

subject: leanrea
title: Prompt-injection exposure: @09ba4aa the skill has no statement that target content is data. Up to ~700 lines of target strings enter context per first move (:23); bundle slices (:31), web pages (:54) and captures (:52) too. Parsers and extractors (jadx, apktool, binwalk -e, unblob -e) and runtime...
evidence: code shows SKILL.md:16-18 (no such rule); rg -i 'untrusted|inject' → no match (anatomy §3, re-confirmed); PR #4 diff
fix: Untrusted-content envelope on every result and a skill statement that target content is data (§4); injection tripwires in the Phase 1 gate (§9).

subject: leanrea
title: Model dependence: Commands are given but adaptation is left to the model: unescape pipes, substitute Linux tools, write hex searches (Hermes, Flutter), write parsers. Assay Haiku, macho-facts 3/3 runs: the model hand-wrote a Python Mach-O parser because otool/lipo were missing. Rep 3: "My first p...
evidence: assay live.json tier0 macho-facts 1, 2, 3; my test on fixture
fix: Built-in readers return parsed facts, so models do not hand-write parsers (§8 Phase 1); skill tested on at least two model tiers (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Coverage and unasked facts: No rule to report what was not examined, and no zip/tar/npm-package rows. Assay zip-slip reps 1 and 3 never examined the sibling update.tar.gz (which has a ../outside.txt member). Rep 2 did, but no rep wrote "gzip", so the grader missed it in all 3. npm-postinstall rep...
evidence: assay live.json tier0 zip-slip 1-3, npm-postinstall 1-3; assay:bench/tasks/zip-slip.json, npm-postinstall.json
fix: zip, tar and npm in the router (§4); coverage per target and operation names what was not examined (§3.5); grader normalises gzip vocabulary (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Workspace hazards: X=$TMPDIR/re/asar; rm -rf $X (:29): with TMPDIR unset, X=/re/asar; unquoted, so a TMPDIR with spaces splits (issue #3 reproduced it). Fixed asar name, so concurrent analyses clobber each other. pe-facts reps 1 and 3 report output at a literal $TMPDIR/re/agent/dis.txt
evidence: my test: X=$TMPDIR/re/asar; echo $X → /re/asar; assay live.json tier0 pe-facts 1, 3
fix: Per-job scratch under REAX_HOME/tmp/<job>, swept at start (§3.3); targets keyed by content digest (§3.5), so concurrent runs never share a path.
note: Triage proposed blocks; the profile states degrades, which stands until the profile is revised.

subject: leanrea
title: Wrong or unverifiable commands: DecompileAll.java not stock (users report, PR #5). go tool nm empty after -s -w (users report, PR #8; consistent with Go toolchain behaviour, inferred). jq -r '.sources[]' lists source names, not contents (inferred). Flutter offset not tested
fix: Router corrections: T10 for Go -s -w, T16 sourcesContent, Flutter offset tested (§4); Ghidra via the pyghidra worker in Phase 2 (§3.6).

subject: leanrea
title: Cost (token size): SKILL.md is 8,374 bytes, 1,294 words, 66 lines. Estimate: about 2.2k–2.6k tokens at 3.2–3.8 bytes/token; I had no tokenizer or API key, so this is not a measured token count. author says: +3.1k tokens when invoked, which includes skill-invocation wrapper text (BENCHMARK.md:60; ...
fix: Generated skill about 2k tokens or less (§4), measured with a tokenizer in CI.

subject: leanrea
title: Vendored copy in Assay is not "unchanged": assay:bench/baseline/leanrea-SKILL.md is 14,657 bytes against upstream 8,374. It was reformatted: padded table, extra blank lines, and the Electron row split into extra cells at every unescaped |. Two rows lost a space (hbc-decompiler..jsc , unzip -l a.a...
fix: The benchmark pins the leanrea skill commit and its digest per cell (§10); Assay already checks the vendored copy's sha256 in test/baseline.test.ts.
note: Already fixed in Assay on 2026-10-26; reax keeps the digest check.

subject: leanrea
title: Activation by description: No version, no platform scope
fix: Generated skill carries a version and supported platforms, pinned by tag (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Work on a copy: cp -c macOS/APFS only
fix: Targets are read in place, read-only, with blobs content-addressed (§3.5), so no APFS clone is needed.

subject: leanrea
title: Per-target work dir + reuse: TMPDIR unset on Linux → /re/...; name-keyed
fix: Work dirs are REAX_HOME/tmp/<job> (§3.3) and results keyed by content digest (§3.5), not by name or TMPDIR.

subject: leanrea
title: Route by file -b + magic: libmagic decides; 2 magic values only
fix: identify uses built-in format readers (§8 C07), with Detect It Easy as a second opinion (§5), instead of two libmagic values.

subject: leanrea
title: Cheap inventory before decompile: none enforced
fix: investigate runs inventory first (§5) and the scheduler serves cheap work first on a reserved lane (§3.7). Not in the plan: deep operations do not require a prior inventory.

subject: leanrea
title: Search hidden trees (rg -uu): requires rg
fix: Full-text search over strings, symbols and notes via FTS5 in Phase 1 (§5), with no rg dependency.

subject: leanrea
title: Slice, never cat: prose only
fix: Caps and handles enforced in the tools (§4); read returns slices by offset.

subject: leanrea
title: Dump disassembly once, grep file: unbounded file; otool format assumed
fix: Disassembly stored in pm tables and blobs and returned in pages (§3.5, §0); capstone wasm or engine output, no otool format assumed.

subject: leanrea
title: Batch probes, echo '--- name' markers: zsh quoting note
fix: inventory returns the batch of cheap facts in one call with no shell quoting (§3.4); CLI output formats are fixed (§3.4).

subject: leanrea
title: Cap every output (head, -m): prose only; models skip it
fix: Output caps are enforced by the tools: inventory < 10k tokens, errors < 8k chars, detail by handle (§0).

subject: leanrea
title: Label claims seen/inferred, cite file:offset or symbol: unchecked; omitted in 6/24 Haiku runs
fix: Labels are required fields and verify checks that cited evidence exists (§4, §8 C32); the grader grades labels (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Unknown ≠ absent: unchecked
fix: Unknowns are records (§8 C31) and coverage states scope (§3.5), so absent is reported only after a complete scoped scan.

subject: leanrea
title: Static ≠ observed execution: unchecked
fix: Runtime observations come only from observe (§3.4) and are labelled separately from static evidence. Not in the plan: a test that static output never carries an observed label.

subject: leanrea
title: Missing tool → row fallback or brew install with consent: fallbacks absent for most rows; Homebrew only
fix: Adapter availability and remediation per platform (§3.6), surfaced by doctor (§8 C40); built-in readers cover most rows without external tools.

subject: leanrea
title: Turn budget 2–4 calls; stop when every asked item has evidence: not enforced; 5/12 benchmark runs exceeded 4 calls
fix: analyze investigate {goal, budget} enforces the call budget and returns stop reasons (§5); turns measured in the benchmark (§4).
note: The planner lands with the C41 prompts in Phase 2 per §8.

subject: leanrea
title: Do not re-verify: trades away self-check
fix: Made moot: verify re-checks deterministically in the tool layer (§8 C32) and cached results make a re-check cheap (§3.5).

subject: leanrea
title: Mach-O one-call inventory: file, lipo, otool -L, exports, imports, strings (≤400), full disassembly to file, function labels (≤150): macOS only. GNU nm: "file format not recognized" on a fat Mach-O (my test). Unquoted $T, $D
fix: Built-in Mach-O reader including fat binaries on every host (§8 C07, C12), with llvm-objdump --macho as the Linux fallback (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Read one function: awk between labels, filter bl/b./cmp/literal: otool label format; arm64 mnemonics
fix: Function reads use engine or capstone boundaries from symbols (§8 C08), not awk over otool labels.

subject: leanrea
title: Electron one-call: asar extract, package.json name/version/main, JS/.node file list (≤60), unpacked addons, exposeInMainWorld files: npx -y unpinned + network; rm -rf $X unquoted; TMPDIR assumed; needs app.asar.unpacked beside archive (users report, PR #5)
fix: @electron/asar linked and read-only, reading app.asar.unpacked in place (§3.8); no npx, no rm -rf, scratch under REAX_HOME/tmp (§3.3).

subject: leanrea
title: Needle slicer across bundle (±250 chars, ≤20 hits): none
fix: FTS5 search (§5) returns bounded snippets with offsets, capped per call (§0).
note: Profile records no limitation for this row ('none'); the lead may drop it.

subject: leanrea
title: Go: go version -m "alone usually answers": needs Go toolchain
fix: Built-in Go buildinfo reader (§8 C12) and GoReSym (§5), with no Go toolchain needed.

subject: leanrea
title: Electron (*.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar): Unescaped | in regex splits the table cell; | sort -u escaped (issue #1)
fix: No tables in the generated skill (§4), so regex alternations cannot split cells; the Electron graph is built-in (§3.8).

subject: leanrea
title: Web bundle / minified JS: .sources[] lists names, not contents (inferred: sourcesContent[] holds the code)
fix: Trap T16 uses sourcesContent (§4) and trace-mapping reads source maps (§3.8).

subject: leanrea
title: Hermes / bytenode / V8: No command for the magic check
fix: hermes-dec as a separate process (§6). Not in the plan: built-in magic detection for Hermes bytecode, bytenode and V8 snapshots in identify (§8 C19).

subject: leanrea
title: Mach-O: Escaped pipes (issue #1). No llvm-objdump --macho fallback, although it works here
fix: llvm-objdump --macho fallback added (§4) and no tables in the skill.

subject: leanrea
title: Native code logic: DecompileAll.java not stock (users report, PR #5); escaped pipes
fix: Decompilation via the pyghidra worker (§3.6), not a non-stock script.

subject: leanrea
title: ELF / PE: One row for two whole platforms; no first move
fix: Built-in ELF and PE readers (§8 C07, C45) and separate ELF and PE first moves in the router data (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Go (__go_buildinfo, .go.buildinfo): "Symbols survive stripping" false for -s -w (users report, PR #8); escaped pipes
fix: Trap T10 for Go -s -w (§4); GoReSym recovers symbols from pclntab (§5).

subject: leanrea
title: Rust: escaped pipes
fix: Built-in Rust reader for cargo-auditable data (§8 C12, §5) and no tables in the skill (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Android APK: jadx/apktool run parsers on untrusted input on the host
fix: JADX and Apktool run in sandboxed child processes with network off (§3.6).

subject: leanrea
title: Flutter snapshot hash: inferred: offsets match the Dart snapshot header layout as I know it; not tested on a file
fix: Flutter offset tested on a fixture (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: pcap / HAR: escaped pipes make the jq filter fail (my test: "syntax error, unexpected INVALID_CHARACTER")
fix: Static HAR is read by a built-in reader under read (§8 C20); no tables in the skill (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: Firmware: Extraction of untrusted images on the host, no sandbox
fix: unblob and binwalk run sandboxed with network off (§3.6, §8 C27).

subject: leanrea
title: Website: Network; runs remote JS in a browser
fix: Browser observation is Phase 3, off by default, approval each time (§8 C20, §13). Not in the plan: how it gets network under the always-network-off sandbox (§3.6).

subject: leanrea
title: Running app / runtime: Starts or attaches to untrusted code; no consent, no cleanup
fix: Runtime operations need approval each time and run sandboxed (§13, §3.6); owned children are recorded and reaped on restart (§3.3).

subject: leanrea
title: Install line (brew, npm -g, dotnet tool, cargo install), "only on request": Homebrew/macOS-centred; unpinned; no Linux or Windows lines
fix: doctor and setup give pinned install remediation per platform (§3.6, §8 C40); skill fallbacks cover Linux and Windows (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: skills CLI install/update to many agents: Updates to repo head; third-party CLI not examined
fix: Skill published pinned by tag (§4). Not in the plan: review what the third-party skills CLI writes during install and update.

subject: leanrea
title: Manual copy or paste into any agent's rules: Paste loses nothing (plain text). Copying the raw table carries |
fix: Generated skill has no tables, so a raw copy carries no escaped pipes (§4).

subject: leanrea
title: One-cell runner: Timeout raises unhandled TimeoutExpired, so no row is written. Bash tool logged by first word only (:42). Answer kept only in gitignored work dir (:50)
fix: Timed-out cells are kept and each cell commits raw transcript and full tool-call record (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Full run, arms side by side: Concurrency on one machine; reps numbered 1..N, but committed file has reps 11-13
fix: Arms run one after another, never concurrently on one machine (§10); results are never hand-edited.

subject: leanrea
title: Target setup: macOS + Notion 7.35.1 + gh built with go1.27.1 only (:18)
fix: Fixtures generated with zig cc from public-domain and permissive sources with pinned digests (§9 0c).

subject: leanrea
title: Task electron: literal-string keys
fix: The grader checks claims against oracle predicates, not literal strings (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Task native: socket key accepts any "unix socket" phrase
fix: Oracle predicates with negative keys and refuted-claim penalties (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Task go: "Go 1.27.1" fails the go1\.27\.1 key; hand-corrected (BENCHMARK.md:41)
fix: Vocabulary normalisation in bench/grade.ts with a self-test (§10); no hand correction of results.

subject: leanrea
title: Task deep: hash, \.sock, JSON match any mention of the word
fix: Predicates grade each claim's content rather than word mentions (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Grading: no negative keys; labels and citations not graded; no grader self-test
fix: Grader penalises refuted claims, grades labels and has a self-test (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Context-overhead probe: raw output not committed
fix: Each cell commits raw transcript and the cached-vs-uncached token split (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: MCP sizer: no readline timeout; EOF exits before kill
fix: Not in the plan explicitly: the tools/list size gate (§3.4, §12) must use the MCP SDK client with a read timeout and kill the server in a finally block.

subject: leanrea
title: Committed results: arm label lean, not leanrea; reps 11-13; a <work> placeholder in one tools string (final.jsonl:17). Not raw harness output
fix: bench/results/ is never hand-edited and holds raw cell records with model id and skill commit (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: Does the skill help weaker models? It was tested only with Sonnet 5.5. Assay's Haiku runs show it works but with adaptation errors (A-9).
fix: Answered by testing the skill on at least two model tiers (§4) and Haiku- and Sonnet-class arms in the pre-registered benchmark (§10).

subject: leanrea
title: How accurate are the labels when they are present? Nobody measures this.
fix: Answered by the grader, which grades labels (§10), and by calibration intervals per question class (§3.5).

subject: leanrea
title: What do the 36 answers actually say? They are not committed.
fix: Moot for reax: every cell commits its raw transcript (§10); leanrea's arm answers are recorded the same way.

subject: leanrea
title: Did the YouTube audience report other problems? The comments were unreadable from here.
fix: Answered for reax by issue mining (tools/mine-issues.ts) into N-* rows (§1); YouTube comments remain unread.

subject: leanrea
title: Will the author merge #4 or #6? There has been no activity on main for 9 days.
fix: Wont candidate, not yet reviewed: An upstream merge decision is outside reax's control and does not change reax. Moot: reax carries its own corrected router data under the MIT credit (§4) and does not depend on upstream merges.

subject: leanrea
title: Would leanrea's advantage over REA hold on multi-step or adversarial tasks? It is untested.
fix: The benchmark has a resume task and an adversarial task (§10). Not in the plan: the Phase 1 gate covers only the cheap-question subset (§9); add those tasks to it.
